question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It is a __misconception__ that the more you learn, the more likely you are to succeed.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Misconception** (भ्रम): means a mistaken belief or idea.

 
 
• **Example:** It is a misconception (भ्रम) that owls are blind during the day.
 
 
 
• **Certainly** (निश्चित रूप से): means without doubt; definitely.
 
 
• **Example:** You will certainly (निश्चित रूप से) succeed if you put in the hard work.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct Antonym is **'Certainty.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option (1) - **Hallucination**: means a sensory experience that is not caused by an external stimulus.(भ्रम)
 
• Option (2) - **Fallacy**: means a mistaken belief, especially one based on poor reasoning.(तर्कदोष)
 
• Option (3) -** Illusion**: means a misleading or deceptive appearance that differs from reality.(धोखा)
